source: claude CLI 2.1.322, stream-json input with --replay-user-messages, two one-message turns (scratch cwd, no tools): one user message whose content is text/image/text/image/text blocks, then one whose content is three text blocks. The CLI echoed each message with its uuid and the blocks unchanged, then answered from all blocks (A=red, B=blue; PINEAPPLE GRANITE). ids removed.

images.text: Message one: the first color image follows.
Message two: the second color image follows.
Message three (no image). Reply with exactly: A=<color of image 1>, B=<color of image 2>.

texts.text: Message one: remember the word PINEAPPLE.
Message two: remember the word GRANITE.
Message three: reply with exactly the two words, in order.
